The '''''D''-class Starfarer''' was a popular small civilian [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] owned one, in which he and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Mission to Zigoola|flew]] to [[Zigoola]].
